sourceSentences: [0] Dodge Braum's (Q) Winter's Bite as much as you can. Getting hit by this means you can never engage on him or his ADC. The best time to engage is when his Unbreakable is down.
[0] If he ever misuses his shield he cannot protect his carry anymore and you're free to jump onto them.
[0] Braum isn't very good into Rell because besides his ultimate stopping her W, he has no real way to stop her from doing anything.
[0] Before any fight, try to escape his Q, because it hurts and slows you down. Don't focus him and you're ok
[0] His R is truly your only threat with it knocks you out of your W, and his shield if you engage to set up for example a Miss Fortune R combo yet you still will manage to kill him.
[1] Rell has a very simple engage in the form of her W, which you can easily if she misses as she loses some movement speed and is easy to catch out.
[1] Whenever she is dismounted, you should look to play aggressive and poke her down. She is very vulnerable and has nothing to stop you from doing it.
[1] Once Rell hits level 6, her Ultimate is a very versatile tool that can allow her to turn around exchanges. Under no circumstances should you try to dive her post 6.
[1] However, Rell can shred your resistances. So be careful in extended fights with her.
[1] Rell is a really good support with a lot of CC. Bait her W and Q and engage after.
